verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents an official CLI that you install to preview docs locally, test changes in real time and catch build errors before deploying, and a probe confirmed the CLI install page exists. The evidence covers only that local-preview and validation scope. Missing for 10: documentation of the wider command set or agent-oriented CLI workflows (e.g. scripting or AI-tool integration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
